what: The rehearsal: a build performed without the build — a build simulator here to identify what's missing (Akien, 2026-10-29; ticket c9897770efe6). Renders a cast ticket as THE PLAN — its title, intention, why, how, falsifier, its live decision lines as steps keyed D<n>, and any scoped lines as context — plus WHAT EXISTS: every path and module the steps cite, measured on disk before the read, never imported (Akien: 'we should be telling it what exists and what doesn't before hand'). Nothing else is handed over: no voyage craft, no landed commits, no chart berths, no charters, no cursor ('the ticket becomes nothing but the build plan. that's what makes this work.'). The cheapest model (Haiku 4.5, via `claude -p --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --output-format json`) reads it three times cold and returns a tree per schema.json — one node per step the plan carries, exactly once, keyed D<n>, or `unlisted: <text>` for a step the build needs that no line names (D17, open-d71a52522428) — each node {step, state: builds | stopped, missing, confidence}: it says 'i got stopped here' and what is missing, and stopped is a legal and expected answer. Code diffs the three trees into gaps of three kinds (stopped, step_absent, unlisted), each carrying what the reads said is missing; CC disposes each as a decision line on the ticket or a question in the inbox, and a clean rehearsal (three reads, zero gaps) is written to CairnCommons/rehearsals/ through the artifact door (verb rehearse). The BUILDME entry lane the_ticket_rehearses_clean (sieve buildme_rides_the_rehearsal in build_inspector) refuses a crossing without a clean record whose design hash still matches. A reading that fails the shape (a step missing or doubled, a state outside the enum, a stopped node naming nothing missing) is handed back to the same reader WITH its lacks named; the first attempt of every read stays cold (D1). The plan's step texts begin with their own D<n> (reader_view, ticket eb1c943e09b9), and a line --decide appended at an unlisted or FIXME step is shown inside the line it settles; only the pasted copy changes, never the file or its hash.
why: A ticket's buildability was a self-report by its own author (/sorted's builder_check: the same mind writes and judges), and the cost of a ticket that only reads as buildable lands on Akien's inbox and on Opus's build. Akien, 2026-09-15: 'we're not measuring yes it has field a but we're measuing if it can be built as written' — 'that gives us almost a hard gate on ticket quality equal to me. and then we run all our tickets thru it, and i don't have to approve them because we know they'll build as we meant.' The gate reads 'no reader has to assume', never 'Haiku's build is the build': the post-PROVED diff of the built proof against the converged tree is the gate's own measurement (Law 8 — a hollow green is worse than a red).
falsifier: DONE when `cairn rehearse <ticket>` over a deliberately underspecified fixture returns gaps naming the underspecified step in all three reads; with the gap answered as a decision line returns zero gaps; a BUILDME crossing without a clean rehearsal is refused by name; the crossing passes with one; a ticket edited after its rehearsal is refused again; the prompt asserts the reader's job, and stopped is a legal answer; the reader is handed only the plan and what exists. WRONG INTENT if over the first ten real tickets Opus's build diverges from the converged tree as often as from un-rehearsed tickets — then the reader measures Haiku's habits, not the ticket.
gates: proof gate (proofs/ under the tester in netns, reader stubbed — no proof tooth calls the real reader)
artifact door (records via verb rehearse; the ticket's rehearsal and decisions fields via verb cast)
WATCHME probe the_rehearsal_predicts_the_build (probes/) — the post-PROVED divergence list, enough at eight clean of ten
how_it_learns: Not yet, by design. v1 records every gap, every decision line and every post-PROVED divergence on the rehearsal record and learns nothing from them; the learning tree that asks the recurring questions before the first read is a child cast after ten records exist, because a tree trained on zero verdicts is the hollow learning the chart chain measured at 0.00. What the machine DOES carry between passes is not learning: a handed-back re-read is told what its previous reading lacked, within one pass only.
owner: CC builds it; codemother owns the care of the code (the lane and the sieve are inspector things, per ruling 2026-09-06-codemother-owns-the-care-of-the-code). The rehearsal records in the commons are records of truth gated by the artifact door.
invoke: CLI: `cairn rehearse <ticket>` prints the gaps; `cairn rehearse <ticket> --decide <step> "<line>" --by <provenance>` (step = D<n>, 'FIXME <k>' or 'unlisted: <text>'): at a D<n> step it rewrites line n in place and logs the old line whole (c9897770efe6 D7; another author's line is refused), at an unlisted step, or a FIXME step with no line yet, it appends D<n+1>; loop cap 5, the sixth pass opens a question on the ticket; the count resets on a clean pass, on his answer to that question, or on any `--decide` (open-8b95d8bb20c5, Akien 2026-09-23: "Reset it fully."). The reader judges each step against the WHOLE plan — a piece another step settles is settled, a later step governs (open-a57cdd7cf3c1). Fired by /sail step 0c after the chart, before BUILDME. `cairn rehearse <ticket> --standing` prints what the lane reads; `--proved <proof path>` after PROVED records the divergence between the converged tree and the built proof's teeth (D14).
filed_edges: (a) transport: the claude CLI carries an 18.9k-token Claude Code preamble per call; a plain-API or inference_proxy transport is a follow-on ticket.
(b) the learning tree over recurring gaps: child cast after ten records.

(c) the reader has no repo access by design; what it may trust about the world is WHAT EXISTS, measured before the read. A stopped step naming a file WHAT EXISTS did not list is a finding against the plan: the step never cited it.

(d) a refused pass (three attempts all failing the shape) writes no record and its cost is unledgered; the record's ticket_sha256 covers the cursor, so `--standing` reads stale after any post-BUILDME crossing.
